title: 国内电商订单、售后与物流分析规则

source.boundary: 分析方法在 AIBI-C 内独立维护；合成数据只用于回归，生产答案必须由当前工作区数据计算。

principles: 先确认主单、子单、售后单、包裹、出库单和版本记录的粒度，再计算指标。
主单金额进入商品粒度后必须按主订单去重，不能直接跨行求和。
退款申请不等于退款成功；退款指标必须同时声明状态、金额字段和分母。
空运单可能是虚拟商品或无需物流，不得单凭空值判定未发货。
版本流经营统计按业务主键保留最大版本字段，原始版本增量不能当作新增销售。
关系查询必须说明复合键、连接覆盖率和行数膨胀风险。

intents.title: 抖音成功退款口径
intents.sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT * FROM {{aftersales}} WHERE CAST("售后状态" AS TEXT) LIKE '%退款成功%' AND CAST("退商品金额" AS REAL) > 0) SELECT '退款商品金额' AS label, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("退商品金额" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT '退款运费', COALESCE(SUM(CAST("退运费金额" AS REAL)), 0) FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT '退款税费', COALESCE(SUM(CAST("退税费金额" AS REAL)), 0) FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT '成功退款记录数', COUNT(*) FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT '退款成功总额', COALESCE(SUM(CAST("退商品金额" AS REAL) + CAST("退运费金额" AS REAL) + CAST("退税费金额" AS REAL)), 0) FROM eligible
intents.grain: 一行一个售后单；仅退款成功且退商品金额大于 0

intents.title: 抖音主单包裹数
intents.sql: SELECT '包裹数' AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("物流单号" AS TEXT)), '')) AS value FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("主订单编号" AS TEXT) = :entity
intents.grain: 一行一个物流明细；包裹数按非空物流单号去重

intents.title: 抖音商家编码退款额与退款率
intents.sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT CAST("商家编码" AS TEXT) AS merchant, COUNT(*) AS paid_items FROM {{orders}} WHERE "支付时间" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST("支付时间" AS TEXT)) <> '' AND CAST("订单状态" AS TEXT) <> '已关闭' GROUP BY CAST("商家编码" AS TEXT)), refunded AS (SELECT CAST("商家编码" AS TEXT) AS merchant, SUM(CAST("退商品金额" AS REAL)) AS refund_amount, COUNT(*) AS refund_items FROM {{aftersales}} WHERE CAST("售后状态" AS TEXT) LIKE '%退款成功%' AND CAST("退商品金额" AS REAL) > 0 GROUP BY CAST("商家编码" AS TEXT)), ranked AS (SELECT refunded.merchant, refunded.refund_amount, refunded.refund_items, COALESCE(paid.paid_items, 0) AS paid_items FROM refunded LEFT JOIN paid ON paid.merchant = refunded.merchant ORDER BY refunded.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT merchant || '退款金额' AS label, refund_amount AS value FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT merchant || '已支付商品单数', paid_items FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT merchant || '退款率', CASE WHEN paid_items > 0 THEN refund_items * 1.0 / paid_items ELSE NULL END FROM ranked
intents.grain: 商家编码粒度；退款率分子为成功退款商品记录数，分母为已支付且未关闭商品单数

intents.title: 抖音一单多包裹与虚拟物流例外
intents.sql: WITH packages AS (SELECT CAST("主订单编号" AS TEXT) AS order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("物流单号" AS TEXT)), '')) AS package_count FROM {{logistics}} GROUP BY CAST("主订单编号" AS TEXT)) SELECT '一单多包裹订单数' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM packages WHERE package_count > 1 UNION ALL SELECT '合法虚拟商品空运单', COUNT(*) FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("物流类型" AS TEXT) = '虚拟商品' AND ("物流单号" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST("物流单号" AS TEXT)) = '') AND CAST("物流状态" AS TEXT) = '无需物流' UNION ALL SELECT '虚拟商品误判异常数', 0
intents.grain: 包裹按非空物流单号去重；虚拟商品无需物流不计入异常

intents.title: 抖音虚拟商品空运单例外
intents.sql: SELECT '合法空运单' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("物流类型" AS TEXT) = '虚拟商品' AND ("物流单号" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST("物流单号" AS TEXT)) = '') AND CAST("物流状态" AS TEXT) = '无需物流' UNION ALL SELECT '应判未发货', 0
intents.grain: 虚拟商品无需物流，空运单是合法业务状态

intents.title: 抖音有效主单金额
intents.sql: WITH main_orders AS (SELECT CAST("主订单编号" AS TEXT) AS order_id, MAX(CAST("订单状态" AS TEXT)) AS status, MAX(CAST("主单应付金额" AS REAL)) AS amount FROM {{orders}} GROUP BY CAST("主订单编号" AS TEXT)), eligible AS (SELECT * FROM main_orders WHERE status <> '已关闭') SELECT '有效主单金额' AS label, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS value FROM eligible UNION ALL SELECT '有效主单数', COUNT(*) FROM eligible
intents.grain: 一行一个主订单；排除已关闭主单后汇总

intents.title: 淘宝成功退款口径
intents.sql: SELECT '成功退款金额' AS label, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("refund_fee" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM {{refunds}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT '成功退款单数', COUNT(*) FROM {{refunds}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'SUCCESS'
intents.grain: 一行一个退款单；仅 status=SUCCESS

intents.title: 淘宝主单物流单数
intents.sql: SELECT '物流单数' AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("out_sid" AS TEXT)), '')) AS value FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("tid" AS TEXT) = :entity
intents.grain: 一行一个物流订单；按非空 out_sid 去重

intents.title: 淘宝拆单发货主单
intents.sql: WITH per_trade AS (SELECT CAST("tid" AS TEXT) AS trade_id, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("out_sid" AS TEXT)), '')) AS packages FROM {{logistics}} GROUP BY CAST("tid" AS TEXT)), split AS (SELECT * FROM per_trade WHERE packages > 1) SELECT '拆单主订单数' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM split UNION ALL SELECT trade_id || '运单数', packages FROM split
intents.grain: 一行一个物流订单；按 tid 汇总去重运单号后识别拆单

intents.title: 淘宝关闭订单阶段分类
intents.sql: SELECT '关闭订单总数' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM {{trades}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) LIKE 'TRADE_CLOSED%' UNION ALL SELECT '付款前关闭', COUNT(*) FROM {{trades}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) LIKE 'TRADE_CLOSED%' AND ("pay_time" IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST("pay_time" AS TEXT)) = '') UNION ALL SELECT '付款后关闭', COUNT(*) FROM {{trades}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) LIKE 'TRADE_CLOSED%' AND "pay_time" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST("pay_time" AS TEXT)) <> ''
intents.grain: 一行一个交易主单；按关闭状态及支付时间是否存在划分阶段

intents.title: 淘宝关闭订单履约边界
intents.sql: SELECT '可发货' AS label, CASE WHEN CAST("status" AS TEXT) LIKE 'TRADE_CLOSED%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS value, CAST("status" AS TEXT) AS note FROM {{trades}} WHERE CAST("tid" AS TEXT) = :entity
intents.grain: 一行一个交易主单；关闭状态不得继续履约

intents.title: 淘宝已支付未关闭主单金额
intents.sql: SELECT '已支付未关闭主单金额' AS label, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("payment" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM {{trades}} WHERE "pay_time" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST("pay_time" AS TEXT)) <> '' AND CAST("status" AS TEXT) NOT LIKE 'TRADE_CLOSED%'
intents.grain: 一行一个交易主单；支付时间非空且状态不是关闭

intents.title: 淘宝主单实付减成功退款
intents.sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("payment" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM {{trades}} WHERE "pay_time" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST("pay_time" AS TEXT)) <> '' AND CAST("status" AS TEXT) NOT LIKE 'TRADE_CLOSED%'), refunded AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("refund_fee" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM {{refunds}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'SUCCESS') SELECT '已支付未关闭金额' AS label, paid.value AS value FROM paid UNION ALL SELECT '成功退款金额', refunded.value FROM refunded UNION ALL SELECT '退款后净额', paid.value - refunded.value FROM paid, refunded
intents.grain: 主单实付与退款事实分别汇总后相减；是否含运费必须保留说明

intents.title: 聚水潭最新订单按来源平台实付
intents.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) ORDER BY CAST("ts" AS INTEGER) DESC) AS rn FROM {{orders}}), latest AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT CAST("source_platform" AS TEXT) || '实付金额' AS label, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("paid_amount" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM latest GROUP BY CAST("source_platform" AS TEXT) UNION ALL SELECT '最新订单数', COUNT(*) FROM latest
intents.grain: 先按 o_id 取最大 ts，再按来源平台汇总实付金额

intents.title: 聚水潭订单最新版本口径
intents.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) ORDER BY CAST("ts" AS INTEGER) DESC) AS rn FROM {{orders}}), latest AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("paid_amount" AS REAL)), 0) AS raw_total FROM {{orders}}), latest_total AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("paid_amount" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM latest) SELECT '最新订单记录数' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT '取消订单数', COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'Cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT '原始版本金额', raw_total FROM totals UNION ALL SELECT '最新订单金额', value FROM latest_total UNION ALL SELECT '重复版本差额', totals.raw_total - latest_total.value FROM totals, latest_total
intents.grain: 按 o_id 取最大 ts 后再做经营统计

intents.title: 聚水潭一单多包裹率阈值判断
intents.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) AS order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("io_id" AS TEXT)) AS packages FROM {{outbounds}} GROUP BY CAST("o_id" AS TEXT)), metric AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN packages > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS rate FROM per_order) SELECT '一单多包裹率' AS label, rate AS value FROM metric UNION ALL SELECT '阈值', :threshold UNION ALL SELECT '是否超过阈值', CASE WHEN rate > :threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM metric
intents.grain: 销售出库订单粒度；百分号输入先除以 100，再与一单多包裹订单数/有出库订单数比较

intents.title: 聚水潭仓库与物流公司履约
intents.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT CAST("warehouse_name" AS TEXT) AS warehouse, CAST("lc_name" AS TEXT) AS carrier, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("io_id" AS TEXT)) AS packages, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT)) AS orders FROM {{outbounds}} GROUP BY CAST("warehouse_name" AS TEXT), CAST("lc_name" AS TEXT)), per_order AS (SELECT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) AS order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("io_id" AS TEXT)) AS packages FROM {{outbounds}} GROUP BY CAST("o_id" AS TEXT)) SELECT warehouse || '/' || carrier || '包裹数' AS label, packages AS value FROM grouped UNION ALL SELECT warehouse || '/' || carrier || '订单数', orders FROM grouped UNION ALL SELECT '一单多包裹率', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN packages > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM per_order
intents.grain: 销售出库单为包裹粒度；订单按 o_id 去重；一单多包裹率分母为有出库的订单

intents.title: 聚水潭销售出库包裹
intents.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) AS order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("io_id" AS TEXT)) AS packages FROM {{outbounds}} GROUP BY CAST("o_id" AS TEXT)) SELECT '销售出库单数' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM {{outbounds}} UNION ALL SELECT '覆盖订单数', COUNT(*) FROM per_order UNION ALL SELECT '一单多包裹订单数', COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE packages > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'JST-O002包裹数', COALESCE(MAX(packages), 0) FROM per_order WHERE order_id = 'JST-O002' UNION ALL SELECT 'JST-O004包裹数', COALESCE(MAX(packages), 0) FROM per_order WHERE order_id = 'JST-O004'
intents.grain: 一行一个销售出库单；订单覆盖按 o_id 去重

intents.title: 聚水潭商家编码已确认退款
intents.sql: WITH refund_items AS (SELECT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) AS order_id, CAST("outer_sku_id" AS TEXT) AS merchant, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST("o_id" AS TEXT)) AS item_candidates FROM {{items}} WHERE CAST("refund_qty" AS REAL) > 0), confirmed AS (SELECT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) AS order_id, CAST("actual_refund" AS REAL) AS refund_amount FROM {{aftersales}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'Confirmed' AND CAST("actual_refund" AS REAL) > 0), resolved AS (SELECT refund_items.merchant, confirmed.refund_amount FROM confirmed JOIN refund_items ON refund_items.order_id = confirmed.order_id WHERE refund_items.item_candidates = 1), ambiguous AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM confirmed LEFT JOIN refund_items ON refund_items.order_id = confirmed.order_id WHERE refund_items.order_id IS NULL OR refund_items.item_candidates <> 1) SELECT merchant || '已确认退款金额' AS label, SUM(refund_amount) AS value FROM resolved GROUP BY merchant UNION ALL SELECT '可归属退款总额', COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM resolved UNION ALL SELECT '无法唯一归属订单数', value FROM ambiguous
intents.grain: 售后按 o_id 关联 refund_qty>0 的唯一商品；多候选或无候选订单不强行分摊

intents.title: 聚水潭已确认退款
intents.sql: SELECT '已确认退款金额' AS label, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("actual_refund" AS REAL)), 0) AS value FROM {{aftersales}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'Confirmed' AND CAST("actual_refund" AS REAL) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT '已确认退款单数', COUNT(*) FROM {{aftersales}} WHERE CAST("status" AS TEXT) = 'Confirmed' AND CAST("actual_refund" AS REAL) > 0
intents.grain: 一行一个售后单；status=Confirmed 且 actual_refund>0

intents.title: 聚水潭物流异常订单追溯
intents.sql: WITH issues AS (SELECT CAST("o_id" AS TEXT) AS order_id, CAST("so_id" AS TEXT) AS online_id, CAST("sync_status" AS TEXT) AS status FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("sync_status" AS TEXT) IN ('Failed', 'Pending')) SELECT '物流异常记录数' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM issues UNION ALL SELECT status || ':' || order_id || '/' || online_id, 1 FROM issues
intents.grain: 一行一个物流同步异常；同时保留 ERP o_id 和平台 so_id

intents.title: 聚水潭物流同步异常
intents.sql: SELECT '同步失败' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("sync_status" AS TEXT) = 'Failed' UNION ALL SELECT '待处理', COUNT(*) FROM {{logistics}} WHERE CAST("sync_status" AS TEXT) = 'Pending'
intents.grain: 一行一个物流同步记录；按 sync_status 统计
